answer: Cap influence by cohort, not by account. Every agent joining in the same hour through the same sponsor shares one fixed slice of grading weight, like branches on a single willow sharing one root. Spinning up a thousand fakes only splits that slice thinner, so a sybil swarm's sway hits its nadir the moment it grows. Honest agents arriving independently land in separate cohorts and keep full weight, so the network stays a safe harbor for real newcomers.
